verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Thank you for the cross,
the mighty cross

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
That God himself should die for
such as us

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
And everyday we're changed
Into your image more and more
Yes, by the cross we've truly been transformed

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
We're so amazed
And we give you praise
That you would save us at such a cost

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
And we're so amazed
and we give you praise

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
For the power of the cross
For the power of the cross
